reserveReview.rationale: Mirrored the live Nest Alpha Vault positions API captured on 2026-08-08. The adapter buckets liquid stablecoins into tracked slices (USDC, pUSD) and nTBILL into the fund-share slice; all unclassified yield strategies (nOPAL, nFALCON, nLCRD, nCLOA, nACRDX) are grouped by the adapter under 'Nest private and structured credit vaults'. That aggregate slice is classified with assetClass private-credit and a concrete issuerOrObligor listing the strategy tokens, so no known-unknown exposure remains.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Nest Alpha Vault positions API snapshot
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Individual private-credit strategy weights are not itemized by the issuer beyond the token-level position values; the adapter's aggregate bucket is classified rather than decomposed.
